name: NumberField
summary: A number in a bordered box with a decrement and an increment button, locale formatting with Western digits, units and bounds.
useWhen: A count or an amount someone types or nudges: seats, guests, a quantity in a cart
A number with bounds and a step, where the step buttons and the arrow keys help
A money amount, a percent or a measure formatted for the locale (SAR, 15%, 2.5 kg)
avoidWhen: A Studio inspector value someone drags to change (width, rotation, opacity)
A rough value picked on a range, where the exact number matters less
A number that is an identifier and never counted: a phone number, a code, a card number

value.description: The value, controlled. null is an empty field.

defaultValue.description: The first value, uncontrolled. Default empty.

onChange.description: Called with the committed value after a step, on blur and on Enter. null when emptied.

min.description: The lowest value. Home goes to it. The decrement button disables at it.

max.description: The highest value. End goes to it. The increment button disables at it.

step.description: One step of the arrow keys and the buttons. PageUp and PageDown move ten steps. When set, a typed value snaps to it on commit.

formatOptions.description: Intl.NumberFormat options: decimals, percent, currency, unit. Digits stay Western unless numberingSystem is set.

locale.description: The locale of the format. Default the language of the nearest Theme, with Western digits (ar-u-nu-latn).

size.description: Height from size.control: 24, 28, 32 and 44 px at default density. The steppers are 24px, and 32px at lg.

shape.description: default takes radius.control from the style. pill is always fully round, with round steppers.

invalid.description: Marks the value invalid. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

disabled.description: Native disabled on the input. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

readOnly.description: Readable and focusable, the steppers hide. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

required.description: Sets aria-required, never native required. Inside a Field it follows the Field.

steppers.description: Shows the decrement and increment buttons.

incrementLabel.description: The accessible name of the increment button. Default Increase and the field name, in the locale.

decrementLabel.description: The accessible name of the decrement button. Default Decrease and the field name, in the locale.

start.description: An icon name, a short text or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden.

end.description: A unit such as px, an icon name or a node. Icon names and texts are aria-hidden: say the unit in the label or use formatOptions.

rootProps.description: Props for the root box. className and style also go to the root; the ref and native input props go to the input.

a11y.role: textbox with aria-roledescription number field, from React Aria. The steppers are buttons with aria-controls on the input.
a11y.focus: The input is the only tab stop. The steppers are out of the tab order and do not take focus on press. Clicking the box outside the steppers focuses the input. Focus shows the glow and a 2px ring around the box.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the input, and on to the next control
keys.Enter: Commits the typed value and formats it

a11y.announce: Name from the Field label or aria-label. A committed value that changes the text is announced. Each stepper is named Increase or Decrease and the field name. The Field description and error through aria-describedby.
notes: Typing allows Western and Arabic Indic digits and the Arabic decimal and thousands marks. They become Western as they are typed or pasted, so the value never jumps on blur.
The value runs left to right in tabular figures, on the reading side of the form.
A typed value that is not a number goes back to the last value on blur.
The mouse wheel never changes the value, so a page scroll over the field is safe.
A caller's onKeyDown does not receive PageUp and PageDown; the field handles them.
No native title attribute. Use the Field description for the bounds.

en.label: A noun in sentence case that says what is counted: Seats, Guests, Width.
en.placeholder: An example at most: For example, 12. Never the bounds; put them in the description.
en.description: The bounds and the step when they are not obvious: Between 1 and 50.
en.error: What to type: Enter a number from 1 to 50.

ar.label: اسم للشي المعدود بدون تشكيل: عدد المقاعد، الكمية، العرض
ar.digits: الأرقام غربية دايم، والأرقام العربية مقبولة وقت الكتابة
ar.error: قل وش يكتب: اكتب رقم من 1 إلى 50

react.behavior: react-aria-components NumberField, rendered with our elements through its render prop
react.note: Motion: fade. Only the focus glow fades (an opacity transition), and the value changes at once: number-roll is for a value someone reads, not one they type.

angular.behavior: div[dsNumberField] with a native input and two dsIconButton steppers, hand built on packages/shared number.ts with React Aria's rules, CDK LiveAnnouncer, ControlValueAccessor
angular.note: Same DOM, keys and words as React (React Aria's English and Arabic stepper names and role description). value is a model: [(value)]; defaultValue is value and onChange is valueChange, fired with each committed change. start and end take an icon name, a short text or a TemplateRef. rootProps, className and style have no input: attributes on the host already land on the root. The hidden input named name sits after the root, as in React. Stepper words exist in English and Arabic only. The mouse wheel never changes the value.

styles.studio: The Input pill with round ghost steppers at the two ends, the glow and the 2px ring on focus
styles.desk: The same box and steppers, in Instrument Sans

mistakes.wrong: Input type number for a count with bounds
mistakes.right: NumberField, which formats, steps, clamps and keeps Western digits

mistakes.wrong: NumberField for a phone number or a code
The unit only in the end adornment, so a screen reader hears a bare number
mistakes.right: The unit in the label (Width, px) or formatOptions with style unit

mistakes.wrong: Arabic Indic digits in the shown value under Arabic
mistakes.right: Western digits; Arabic Indic digits are accepted on input

mistakes.wrong: Stacked chevron steppers inside a 32px box
mistakes.right: The two 24px steppers at the ends, so each is a full target
